codex_local.lane_qualification_evidence: Codex CLI 0.154.0 driven locally by services.agentops.executors.CodexCliExecutor on 2026-09-19. Writable smoke run on a throwaway worktree: edited a tracked file and returned turn.completed with usage, 15.4s. Read-only review run at high effort read a real 1500-line diff of commit d5fd09a and returned four findings, three of which were genuine defects that are fixed in 47bcf7c. Subscription-backed via codex login, no API key. Model and effort are passed as -m and -c model_reasoning_effort, so unlike codex_cloud the routed tier is applied rather than advisory.
